description: Connection 0 is a KLINE connection with the smallest id and its own pings (it WOULD be the primary connection if its events were replay inputs: the failure of the G-1 demo_topology_conflict). It carries sixteen kline frames (MALFORMED as forceOrder frames), a frame that is not JSON, and a frame with a top-level st and o.ps = 1. None of it is a replay input: the SLOT is identical to the SLOT of V01 (primary 1, ledger COUNTED 5, n_messages 5, no void) and there is no FORCE finding.
title: a KLINE connection with a smaller id, sixteen kline frames, a garbage frame and an anomalous frame
